# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion 15_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

# Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code extension integration.
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion 15_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if(EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()

set(PICO_BOARD pico CACHE STRING "Original Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040)")
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)
project(arcade_display C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
pico_sdk_init()

add_executable(arcade_display main.c display.c)
target_include_directories(arcade_display PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
target_link_libraries(arcade_display pico_stdlib)
target_compile_options(arcade_display PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(arcade_display 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(arcade_display 0)
pico_add_extra_outputs(arcade_display)
